name: io.github.learn-automated-testing/selenium-ai-agent
title: Selenium AI Agent
description: Selenium MCP: plan, generate and heal tests; pytest by default, any language; Selenium Grid

environmentVariables.name: SELENIUM_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: Run the browser in headless mode

environmentVariables.name: SELENIUM_MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to load: core, recording, planner, generator, healer, analyzer, grid or all

environmentVariables.name: SELENIUM_GRID_URL
environmentVariables.description: Selenium Grid hub URL, e.g. http://localhost:4444 (enables parallel execution)

environmentVariables.name: SELENIUM_ATTACH_CDP
environmentVariables.description: Attach to an already running Chrome at host:port, e.g. 127.0.0.1:9222

environmentVariables.name: SELENIUM_MCP_OUTPUT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: stdout returns data to the LLM; file saves screenshots and outputs to disk
